title: Shoreline Lake Boathouse
specs: Located in a protected wildlife refuge
All participants must be a minimum of 2 years old for rentals and Non-Profit Paddle Days
Introductory private lessons require a 2-hour minimum
Scouts must attend both days to earn merit badges
Private lessons available for individuals or groups; groups of 4+ should contact for tailored classes and quotes
Non-profit groups of 25-200 people can book Paddle Days
includes: Lifejackets included in Non-Profit Paddle Days
PFDs available for rent for $5 each
blurb: Guests can take private or group lessons in sailing, windsurfing, kayaking, and standup paddleboarding. The Boathouse rents watersports equipment and offers scouting programs tailored to earning awards or merit badges. The facility is located in a protected wildlife refuge with a daily launch fee for personal equipment.
extraNote: All rental bookings are non-refundable · Daily launch fee of $7 per vessel or yearly launch fee of $150 for personal equipment · Boathouse at Shoreline Lake, Mountain View, CA
